# Pixel Bill Splitter

A small offline bill splitter for three people. Add an item and its price, select each person who shared it, and set a tip percentage to see what each person owes.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. No installation, server, or internet connection is needed.

## Calculation

Each item's price is stored in cents. When an item has multiple sharers, cents are divided evenly; any leftover cents go to selected people in the displayed order (Alex, Blair, Casey). The tip is applied to each person's item share and rounded to the nearest cent. The bill total is the sum of the displayed person totals.
